# Routes

Every route of ContentKit's HTTP API (178). `contentkit.Engine.Routes` returns them under the host's prefix (`contentkit.Routes.Prefix`), each module a route group at its sub-path: kinds `/v1`, content `/v1`, contents `/v1`, upload `/v1/media/upload`, media `/v1/media`, codes `/v1/codes`, entities `/v1`, channels `/v1`, versions `/v1`, discovery `/v1`, import `/v1`. Request and response names are the schemas of [`api/openapi.json`](../../api/openapi.json), which also lists each route's query parameters and error codes.

**Tier** is what a route requires of its caller, enforced by ContentKit's gate over the host's `auth.Authenticator`, asked at most once per request: `open` (anyone; never authenticates), `public` (anonymous without a credential, else the one it proves; the host's resolver decides what it sees), `user` (a signed-in person, else 401 `unauthorized`, 403 `forbidden` for an application), `staff` (a person or an application holding the permission named, one of `access.Permissions()`, in the root scope of the host's auth, else 403 `forbidden`), `editor` (signed in, else 401 `unauthorized`; staff holding the permission named, or the target's own editors: its creators, a user-owned group's owner and holders of `{kind}:settings:manage` in its AuthKit scope, else 403 `forbidden`). A credential that fails is 401 `unauthorized` with the provider's `WWW-Authenticate` challenge on every tier but `open`; an auth outage is 503 `unavailable`.

Every error is `{"error", "code", …}`; the codes are at the end.

Anonymous readers can send `ContentKit-Reader-Preferences: {"filters":[{"group_id":"configured entity ID","visible":false}]}`. Reads that apply content filters merge these choices over the entrypoint defaults; authenticated accounts always use their saved settings. The header is limited to 8 KiB and 128 configured filters, rejects malformed values and duplicate or unknown IDs, and never grants access. Allow this header in the host's CORS policy. Browser clients should persist choices locally and prune removed filter IDs against `GET /v1/content-filters` without the header. After registration, `POST /v1/me/content-filters/initialize` adopts choices only for its matching `account_id` and only if no settings exist.

## The site's content model (`/v1`)

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/kinds` | open | — | 200 `ContentModel` | The site's content model: languages, tiers, content kinds, entity kinds, whether signals are recorded now and people's avatar preset. Cacheable for a minute. |

## Contents: content items, versions, catalog totals (`/v1`)

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/events` | staff `root:content:view-restricted` | — | 200 `EventPage` | Read this app's immutable catalog events in committed order. Readers save their own cursor; reading acknowledges or deletes nothing. Omitting after starts at the oldest retained event. Event-type filters are bound to the continuation; expired or reset cursors require a current-state resync. Query: `after`, `limit`, `types`, `type`. |
| GET | `/v1/catalog/totals` | open | — | 200 `Totals` | Each kind's content, in all and per language: how many items an anonymous visitor's listing shows and opens, and how many each tier's holders open. The request's site scope applies. Cacheable for ten minutes. Query: `kinds`, `languages`. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}` | public | — | 200 `Content` | A content item: its text in the viewer's language, live versions with their segments and access, groups and attributes; the body only to viewers who open a version, everyone else its description and the paywall decision. Editors see every version and every language. Query: `language`. |
| GET | `/v1/versions/{vid}` | public | — | 200 `Content` | A version by its globally generated id: returns its parent content detail with only this edition selected, including shared and version-specific entities. The same visibility and access rules apply as on the parent's page; hidden versions never fall back to a sibling. Query: `language`. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{vid}` | public | — | 200 `Version` | One version of a content item as the viewer sees it, with its segments and access decision; vid is its id or code. Query: `language`. |
| GET | `/v1/manage` | public | — | 200 `Content[]` | Content items to manage, newest first: drafts, scheduled, held and live ones; deleted ones on their own. App content:write holders see all; others see their own posts with current edit-own permission, or a channel's original posts when they currently edit that channel. Query: `state`, `channel_id`, `access`, `tier`, `q`, `code`, `ids`, `language`, `limit`, `offset`. |
| GET | `/v1/manage/{kind}` | public | — | 200 `Content[]` | Content items to manage for one configured kind. Uses the same permissions and filters as the cross-kind /manage listing. Unknown kinds return not_found. Query: `state`, `channel_id`, `access`, `tier`, `q`, `code`, `ids`, `language`, `limit`, `offset`. |
| GET | `/v1/manage/{kind}/count` | public | — | 200 `ManageCount` | How many items of one kind the caller manages under the /manage/{kind} filters: exact up to 10,000; beyond that, truncated marks a lower bound. Query: `state`, `channel_id`, `access`, `tier`, `q`. |
| POST | `/v1/contents` | public | `ContentInput` | 201 `Content` | Creates a content item as a draft, with one version serving its text's languages when it names none. Staff with root:content:write may create anywhere. Signed-in people with root:content:create may create their own unowned posts; channel posts require that channel's owner or {kind}:content:create/write grant. Creator credits are attribution, not editorship. |
| PATCH | `/v1/contents/{id}` | public | `ContentPatch` | 200 `Content` | Edits a content item's access, restrictions, attributes or creators. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/restore` | public | — | 200 `Content` | Restores an independently deleted content item as it was. A parent deleted with its last version is restored by restoring a version instead. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/publish` | public | `PublishInput` | 200 `Content` | Accepts durable publication now, or schedules it for publish_at. Processing and publication may continue in the background; live becomes true only after completed publication. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/unpublish` | public | — | 200 `Content` | Returns a published or scheduled content item to a draft. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| PUT | `/v1/contents/{id}/creators` | public | `CreatorsInput` | 200 `Content` | Replaces a content item's creators. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/images` | public | `BodyImageInput` | 200 `InlineImage` | Returns a reference and editor preview for an inline image uploaded to the selected version. No sibling version is changed. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions` | public | `VersionInput` | 201 `Version` | Adds a version after the others, a draft unless state says otherwise. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| PUT | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/order` | public | `OrderInput` | 200 `Content` | Orders a content item's versions: ids lists each version that is not deleted, first first. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| PATCH | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{vid}` | public | `VersionInput` | 200 `Version` | Edits a version: languages, traits, label, state and schedule, access, attributes, text, segments and cover; a hidden version takes its cover, own access policy or state=published to restore it. Publication is durably accepted and remains pending while its media is processing. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| DELETE | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{vid}` | public | — | 204 — | Soft-deletes a version, including a kind's single hidden version. Deleting the last undeleted version also soft-deletes its parent. Restoring a version restores an automatically deleted parent. Purchased content remains accessible to its holders until the deletion retention expires and physical purge removes its media. Billing products and purchase history remain archived. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| PUT | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{vid}/segments` | public | `SegmentsInput` | 200 `Version` | Replaces a version's chapters: ordered start markers naming virtual manifest files, with optional publication schedules. A chapter becomes released only after its durable publication completes. The authenticated author with current edit-own permission in the relevant app/channel, current channel content:write holders, or app content:write holders only. Author credits do not grant authority. |
| PUT | `/v1/channels/{id}/reposts/{content_id}` | editor `root:content:write` | — | 200 `ChannelRepost` | Idempotently reposts a published original into a channel the caller may post to; original ownership and access remain unchanged. |
| DELETE | `/v1/channels/{id}/reposts/{content_id}` | editor `root:content:write` | — | 204 — | Removes only the destination repost reference. Requires destination editorship or the original reposter's current posting permission. |

## Media uploads (`/v1/media/upload`)

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/presign` | editor `root:content:write` | `PresignBody` | 200 `PresignReply` | Plans one upload after checking its path's rules and CanUpload: exists (commit directly), one PUT, or a multipart ticket. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/copy` | staff `root:import:write` | `CopyBody` | 200 `CopyReply` | Stages server-side copies of keys of the item's bucket outside ContentKit's namespaces, for one commit's puts (an importer's files). |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/parts` | editor `root:content:write` | `PartsBody` | 200 `PartsReply` | Presigns multipart parts, each bound to its SHA-256. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/parts/list` | editor `root:content:write` | `TicketBody` | 200 `PartsReply` | The parts of a multipart upload that landed, to resume it. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/complete` | editor `root:content:write` | `TicketBody` | 200 `CompleteReply` | Assembles a multipart upload; blob is its staged name. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/abort` | editor `root:content:write` | `TicketBody` | 204 — | Abandons a multipart upload. |
| POST | `/v1/media/upload/commit` | editor `root:content:write` | `CommitBody` | 200 `CommitReply` | Applies ops to an item in one conditional write, then queues placement and processing; answers its uploads as an editor reads them. |
| GET | `/v1/media/upload/frame` | editor `root:content:write` | — | 200 `image/jpeg` | A JPEG still of a video upload, for the frame picker (UploadOptions.Frames). Query: `kind`, `id`, `version`, `path`, `t`, `w`. |

## Media reads and playback (`/v1/media`)

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/media/presets` | open | — | 200 `PresetRule[]` | Every kind's public preset rules: crop bounds, widths and default images. Current image URLs come from a read's public. |
| GET | `/v1/media/{kind}/{id}` | public | — | 200 `ReadResult` | Released files under a prefix in manifest order. Offset/limit or repeated path selects which get URLs. Version access covers its private folder; optional restricted integrations use exact-file tokens. Explicit editor reads can inspect unserved source/prepared files through short-lived storage URLs. Unreadable files are omitted. Query: `prefix`, `path`, `offset`, `limit`, `download`, `editor`, `status`, `after`. |

| GET | `/v1/media/{kind}/{id}/versions/{version}` | public | — | 200 `ReadResult` | A content version's item, read as GET /{kind}/{id} reads any other kind's item. Query: `prefix`, `path`, `offset`, `limit`, `download`, `editor`, `status`, `after`. |

| Method | Path | Tier | Request | Response | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/page-notices` | editor `root:content:write` | — | 200 `PageNotices` | Editors: the version's undismissed notes about automatic page changes: pages removed as blank, duplicate or covered by a two-page spread, and archives reordered into natural name order. They never block saving or publishing. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/page-notices/{notice}/dismiss` | editor `root:content:write` | — | 204 — | Editors: hides a current page notice; repeating it changes nothing. |
| POST | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/page-notices/{notice}/restore` | editor `root:content:write` | — | 200 `PageNotices` | Editors: puts a removed-pages notice's pages back in their original positions and clears the notice. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/reader` | public | — | 200 `ReaderPlan`<br>202 `Pending` | A version's reader plan: its segments with their release state, the canonical version item for released spans, signed previews of a locked version, playback and reader metadata. 202 while it has no current publication. |
| PUT | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/reader` | editor `root:content:write` | `ReaderMeta` | 204 — | Sets a version's reader metadata (editors and staff): anchors and audio cues on its pages and audio uploads. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/download` | public | — | 200 `FileDownload`<br>202 `Pending` | Grants a version's download, what its kind's download serves (the original, a rendition, its pages as a zip), as the host's download policy allows and names, charged to the viewer's download quota: a FileDownload whose short-lived URL serves it as an attachment. The URL is the media host's for an already served file, or the existing archive transfer route's for a ZIP or internal original/rendition (relative to this one). Includes only the released, download-authorized pages in manifest order. 202 while it is prepared; 403 download_unavailable with the policy's reason and available_at; 409 no_download when the version has nothing to serve. |
| GET | `/v1/contents/{id}/versions/{version}/archive` | public | — | 200 `application/zip`<br>200 `application/octet-stream`<br>202 `Pending` | Streams the ZIP or exact configured single file a download granted after repeating access, publication, chapter and policy checks. Internal originals and HostOnly renditions never gain a gateway URL. Ordinary ZIPs are generated on demand and cached privately; personalized ZIPs are never cached. Signed editor authority and token-tier claims delegate only this transfer until ticket expiry, like a private media URL. 404 for an expired, stale or foreign ticket. Query: `for`, `account`, `account_set`, `kind`, `editor`, `claims`, `mark`, `name`, `file`, `revision`, `pages`, `ticket`. |

Records that fail are reported and the rest written; their rebuild jobs are queued. |

## Error codes

Clients branch on `code`; `error` is a message for people and may change.

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `animation_not_allowed` | 422 | An animated image where the upload path refuses animation. |
| `animation_too_long` | 422 | The animation has more frames or seconds than the processor allows. |
| `animation_unsupported` | 415 | An AVIF or HEIF image sequence, which is decoded as one frame. |
| `checksum_mismatch` | 422 | The stored bytes differ from the declared SHA-256. |
| `comment_banned` | 403 | The actor is banned from commenting on this target; `ban` says the scope, the reason and when it ends. |
| `comment_moderated` | 403 | The comment is held for review or was rejected, so its author can't edit it; a reviewer's approval makes a held one editable again. |
| `comment_too_long` | 422 | The comment is longer than the site allows; `details.max` is the limit in characters. |
| `comments_closed` | 403 | The target's comments are closed or hidden: existing ones may show, new ones and edits are refused. |
| `comments_locked` | 403 | The actor can't open the content (or the comment's version), so its comments take no writes from them; reads withhold them. |
| `conflict` | 409 | A concurrent change, a path or slug already taken, or an operation id already used for another commit. |
| `download_unavailable` | 403 | The host's download policy refuses this download now: `reason` is its code, `available_at` when it opens if a matter of time. Nothing was charged. |
| `duplicate_comment` | 422 | An identical comment was already saved in the configured duplicate window. |
| `event_cursor_expired` | 410 | The event cursor predates retained history or names a reset stream; resync current state before continuing. |
| `forbidden` | 403 | The actor may not do this. |
| `gone` | 410 | The content was removed. |
| `image_too_large` | 413 | The image has more pixels or frames than the processor decodes. |
| `image_too_small` | 422 | The edited image is narrower than its public preset's minimum width. |
| `image_unreadable` | 422 | The file is not a decodable image of its declared type. |
| `incomplete` | 409 | A multipart upload is missing parts. |
| `internal_error` | 500 | A server fault; the cause is in the server log. |
| `invalid_request` | 400 | The request is malformed: its body, a query parameter or a path value. |
| `limit_reached` | 409 | The owner already has as many groups of the kind as the site allows (max_per_owner). |
| `moderation_rejected` | 422 | The moderator refused the text; `error` says why. |
| `no_download` | 409 | The version has no file its kind's download serves: nothing uploaded, or its upload failed or was dropped. |
| `not_configured` | 501 | The capability needs a port the host did not configure; retrying does not help. |
| `not_found` | 404 | Nothing by that name, or nothing the actor may see. |
| `not_joinable` | 409 | The group has no free offer to join: it sells its membership, or nothing. |
| `not_ready` | 409 | A version that would go live still has files processing or a publication not yet current; `error` says what. Retry once processing finishes. |
| `not_uploaded` | 409 | A commit names an upload that has not landed; `blobs` lists the ones to upload again. |
| `quota_exceeded` | 413 | The uploader's storage quota is used up. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests; retry after `retry_after` seconds (also the Retry-After header). |
| `tenant_mismatch` | 500 | A host port answered with another tenant's data: a configuration fault. |
| `too_large` | 413 | The file is larger than its upload path allows; `details` has `size` and `max_bytes`. |
| `too_many_files` | 409 | The commit would put more files in an upload path, or the item, than allowed; `details.max` is the limit. |
| `type_not_allowed` | 415 | The file type is not allowed in the upload path; `details.allowed` lists the types. |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | The request needs a valid credential: it has none where the route needs one, or one that is expired, revoked or invalid. WWW-Authenticate says which. |
| `unavailable` | 503 | The host's auth, media storage or signal plane cannot be reached, or a commit's recovery is pending; retry. |
| `upgrade_required` | 503 | The media item was stored before v0.68 and must be migrated using ContentKit v0.119.1 before this release can read it. |
| `video_aspect_unsupported` | 422 | The video's display aspect is outside what its upload path accepts; `details` has `min_aspect` and `max_aspect` (width/height). |
| `video_over_budget` | 422 | The planned encode costs more than its upload path allows, or the source averages under a frame a second. |
| `video_too_large` | 422 | The video's frames are larger than its upload path allows. |
| `video_too_long` | 422 | The video or audio runs longer than its upload path allows. |
